description: This Java class defines an ApiVersion model used to handle different supported API versions within the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It provides methods for parsing version strings, comparing versions, and checking feature support based on version thresholds.

classes.name: ApiVersion
classes.description: Represents an API version with major and minor components, supporting comparison, parsing, and feature checks based on version.

methods.name: ApiVersion(int major, int minor)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the API version with major and minor numbers.

methods.name: ApiVersion(String originalVersion, int major, int minor)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the API version with a string representation and major/minor components.

methods.name: of(String versionString)
methods.description: Parses a version string to create a new ApiVersion instance.

methods.name: extractNumber(String containsNumbers)
methods.description: Extracts numeric part from a string using regex pattern.

methods.name: compareTo(@NonNull ApiVersion compare)
methods.description: Compares this version to another version based on the major version.

methods.name: supportsFileSuffixChange()
methods.description: Checks if the API version supports changing file suffixes (supported from version 1.3).

methods.name: supportsNotesPathChange()
methods.description: Checks if the API version supports changing notes path (supported from version 1.2).

methods.name: equals(Object o)
methods.description: Checks equality based on version comparison.

methods.name: hashCode()
methods.description: Provides hash code based on major and minor version.

methods.name: toString()
methods.description: Returns string representation of the ApiVersion object.
